events.title: A proof of the Grothendieck join-meet positivity
events.summary: This experimental talk features Rui Xiong explaining a proof of the Grothendieck join-meet positivity using geometric Satake. The talk includes an AI-generated video of the proof, followed by a vote on which presentation was better.

evidence.description: This experimental talk has two parts. In the first 30 mins, I'll explain our proof of the join-meet positivity using geometric Satake. In the last 20 mins, I'll play an AI-generated video of the proof. In the last few minutes, we'll vote on who did a better job: me or the AI. Happy to hear any thoughts/complaints from the audience.

events.title: Graduate Workshop Series | History, Memory, Research, and Creative Practice with Dr. Haekyoung Lee
events.summary: Explore modern Korean history, archival methodology, public history, and creative practice in this 5-part graduate workshop series. Led by Dr. Haekyoung Lee, it delves into historical connections and diasporic networks, offering insights for interdisciplinary graduate students.

evidence.description: This is a 5-part Graduate Workshop Series led by Dr. Haekyoung Lee, Professor Emerita of Theater Arts at Kookmin University. Designed for graduate students across disciplines, this series explores modern Korean history, archival methodology, public history, and creative practice.

events.title: GalleryDAAS presents Women Warriors of the African Diaspora
events.summary: Explore an exhibit celebrating women warriors of the African Diaspora, featuring historical figures and contemporary activists. Discover their courage, resilience, and contributions through multimedia pieces and personal reflections, highlighting their impact as leaders and advocates.

evidence.description: GalleryDAAS is pleased to present an exhibit focused on women warriors of the African Diaspora, both conventional and nonconventional, including legends such as Harriet Tubman, Audre Lorde, Wangari Maathai, Zora Neale Hurston, Nanny of the Maroons and Hatshepsut.
